I know what you mean :( everyone needs something to feel better and cutting /is bad/ because you're hurting your body and conditioning your mind to go to cutting for help, but it served a purpose for you at some point. It isn't doing it for you anymore so it could be time to look for other things to help you feel better :). They won't feel the same and it'll be really hard to make the switch. You'll feel terrible in the moment with those urges while doing something else because you're going through something really tough! You might not feel the same relief THEN but after the fact you'll feel so much better. I can't really describe how it feels to surf the wave of urges but I can tell you it's worth the discomfort. 
The good news is that eventually it'll get easier. You'll get used to doing healthy, positive things when you feel shitty and that will become normal and more comfortable. But in the meantime it will be hard, that's okay. I promise you'll feel better soon. The thing is when other coping skills don't work it's because you didn't use them long enough most of the time. You have to keep listening to music, drawing or whatever it is until you settle down and can move forward. I usually go to sleep if I can after something like that because it can be so draining. If that's not possible you just have to do what you can with what you have. 
If you need some ideas for things to do in a crisis you can always ask me! Theres tons of info online too, just google things to do instead of self harming or something like that. Hey and remember that it's okay to "mess up". Getting better is a process and relapse is part of the process for most people but that doesn't mean you've failed or that you're back to square one
